card.category: Usenet NZB index (vBulletin forum, no API)
card.summary: Registration is free. Reported allowance on a free account: 1 NZB per day and limited forum access; no API because it is a forum.

record.category: Usenet NZB index (vBulletin forum, no API)

free_tier.stated: Registration is free. Reported allowance on a free account: 1 NZB per day and limited forum access; no API because it is a forum.
free_tier.notes: The allowance is third-party; the forum pages do not state a number.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file, never the payload

retention.stated: not stated on the forum pages read. A third-party listing claims 'Approximately 500 days retention, 50+ newsgroups indexed'.

egress.terms: No byte metering; the answer is an NZB pointer file.

record.interface_detail: A forum: NZBs are downloaded through the web UI after login. A third-party listing states there is no API and no integrations.
record.tooling: A wrapper has to log in and drive the forum pages; Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 cannot add a forum as a Newznab indexer. That is a tooling note, not a verdict.
record.chaining: A manual fallback for a name when the API indexers have failed; 1 NZB a day makes it a last-resort grab, not a bulk path.

limits.value: reported: 1 NZB per day on a free account

record.binding_note: The one NZB a day is the only numeric limit named, and it is third-party.

identity_cost.detail: Registration needs an email address that can receive mail (the rules ban several mail providers because password reset would not work) and the member's statement of being at least 18 years old; no card is asked.

record.reliability_note: A third-party listing records 95.5% uptime; the forum answered with 2,079 active users.
record.confidence_note: The free registration and the email requirement are first-party text; the 1 NZB a day figure is third-party and undated.
